segments.text: I'm not a smart man, but I know what love is.
My name's Forrest Gump. People call me Forrest Gump.
Sometimes I guess there just aren't enough rocks.
There's an awful lot you can tell about a person by their shoes.

note: The default retains the combined four-scene reference that the user preferred in the single-synthesis comparison. The continuous love-only clip is kept as reference-single-clip for comparison. Source clips and cuts are preserved; transcripts come from the supplied screenshot with local Parakeet alignment checks.
